reason.content: In Step 14 the agent was instructed to apply both a 2+ bedrooms filter and a 2+ bathrooms filter. However, the agent only applied the bedroom filter (the screenshot shows the filter panel set to “2+ bd, 0+ ba” and the bathrooms field remained “Any”). It also did not restrict the results to the required date range (June 1 2022 – May 15 2024). Because the bathroom filter was not applied, the search returned many properties that have fewer than two bathrooms, including a house in Yakima, WA that was incorrectly interpreted as a PEI listing. The downstream steps then operated on an incorrect dataset, leading to the final answer of “67 Maclellan Rd” and the failure to identify the correct smallest house of 1,148 sq ft. A correct Step 14 would have set both the bedrooms and bathrooms filters to a minimum of 2, and applied a date range filter (or used the Zillow search parameters to limit results to the specified period).
